verdict.rationale: OpenTofu explicitly positions itself as a drop-in, backwards-compatible replacement for Terraform, and community reports (including real client migrations and "s/terraform/opentofu/g") corroborate that existing Terraform configs and state can be migrated with minimal effort; hands-on probes confirm the CLI runs standard Terraform-style plan/apply/destroy workflows without modification. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party migration guide or documented state-file conversion/validation step (beyond general 'drop-in' claims), and independent verification of state-file compatibility across complex/large codebases.
